question: How does complete burning in the mouth result in purification?
premises: Something is completely burnt in the mouth by that.
This burning occurs as a prior condition.
Purification can be obtained after that burning.
inference: Complete burning in the mouth serves as the means by which purity is obtained.
uncertainties: The referent of tayā is not specified within this verse.
plain_english: When it is completely burnt in the mouth by that, one may then obtain purity.
